name: naksha-geosphere
description: Naksha GeoSphere — The Geospatial Data Marketplace (engineering foundation)

scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up --build -d
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml logs -f
scripts.docker:prod:config: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml config
scripts.docker:prod:build: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml build
scripts.docker:remote:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml -f compose.remote-storage.yaml up --build -d
scripts.docker:remote:down: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml -f compose.remote-storage.yaml down
scripts.docker:remote:logs: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml -f compose.remote-storage.yaml logs -f
scripts.api:migrate: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:test: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml exec api pytest
scripts.api:lint: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml exec api ruff check .
scripts.worker:ping: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml exec worker celery -A worker.main call system.ping
scripts.worker:test: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local-storage.yaml -f compose.local-storage.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml exec worker pytest
